files.role: Implements page-bounded attempt recording, checkpoint restoration, and process-error surfacing for score-stage batch preamble.
Adds regression coverage for paged attempt recording, checkpoint reuse, and concrete process-error surfacing.
Adds client support for batch-preparation progress persistence.
Adds durable batch-preparation checkpoint fields to llm_batch_executions.
Exposes persisted batch-preparation progress mutation/query fields.
Adds a regression test covering persisted batch-preparation checkpoints on reused batch executions.
Documents the new score-stage batch-preamble semantics for operators.
